subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, existing `/new <model>`, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start and provider/model-routing semantics, so automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Add a typed policy that keeps defaults explicit and covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing without separate competing knobs.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only Default
options.body: Treat static acknowledgements as the default contract and expose startup/model greeting behavior only through an explicit opt-in policy if maintainers want that capability.

options.title: Defer New Reset Controls
options.body: Leave current acknowledgement-only behavior plus `/new <model>` in place and continue tracking prompt text or fallthrough behavior in the narrower related items.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Add a typed policy that keeps defaults explicit and covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing without separate competing knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current bare reset acknowledgement contract and the prior policy review on this issue.
